ashare_names.note: 主力 net-rate (super-large + large orders); velocity = standardized 4-week inflow rate, acceleration = its trend.

ashare_sectors.note: Per-sector big-money flow = equal-weight member main-money net-rate, ranked by 4-week velocity. Expand a sector for its biggest-moving member names.

hk_names.note: Per HK name: how much of it the mainland Connect crowd holds (% of free float) and whether it is ADDING (5-/10-day change in holding value). HK's dominant marginal buyer — a flow confirmer for sizing, not a standalone alpha.

note: Display-only positioning lens — flow is never scored into an allocation signal. Velocity = standardized net-flow rate; acceleration = its 2nd derivative.
